questions.question: The Pritzker Prize is an international award given to recognize contribution in the field of ________.
questions.solution:
The correct answer is __**architecture.**__

• This award is held to honor architects whose built work demonstrates a combination of talent, vision, and commitment. 
 
• It was established by the **Pritzker family of Chicago** through their Hyatt Foundation in 1979.
 
• It is also referred to as “Architecture’s Nobel”.
 
• Award-$100,000 (US) and a bronze medallion.
 
• Pritzker Prize 2020- Yvonne Farrell and Shelley McNamara: They are the only fourth and fifth women to get this its 41-year history

questions.question: What does 'T' stand for in ATM?
questions.solution:

questions.question: Which among the following has its refractive index closest to that of crown glass?
questions.solution:
__
 
• **Canada balsam**__ has its refractive index closest to that of crown glass among the given options. 
 
• Refractive Index is equal to the ratio of the velocity of light in a vacuum to its velocity of the light in a specified medium we are comparing with.
 
• In other words, this index helps us understand how and how much light would bend in the specified medium.
 
• The index has no unit.
 
• Refractive Index of Crown Glass - 1.52-1.62
 
• Refractive Index of Canada balsam - 1.54

 
• Refractive Index of Sapphire - 1.76 – 1.77

 
• Refractive Index of Ruby - 1.76 – 1.77
 
• Refractive Index of Diamond - 2.417 – 2.419

questions.question: With reference to the Vedangas, which of the following terms denotes 'Ritual'?
questions.solution:
__
 
• Vedanga is a Sanskrit word. It means limbs of the Veda. 
 
• These are the treatises of Vedic Literature. They are - Shiksha, Kalpa, Vyakarana, Nirukta, Chandas, and Jyotisha.
 
• Shiksha - It includes the rules of phonetics – sounds of syllables, of pronunciation. 
 
• **Kalpa**__ - It is called the arms of the Veda Purusha. It is for the proper application of the Vedic texts. The texts are clear, short and practical for ceremonies.
 
• Vyakarana - It talks about the formation of the word. It also discusses the root and suffix of a word to study its meaning.
 
• Nirukta - It gives the meaning of the usage of words. 
 
• Chandas - It is designed for the purpose of securing the proper reading and reciting of Vedic texts.
 
• Jyotisha - It conveys the knowledge of the heavenly bodies. It also gives some rules for calculating and fixing time for sacrifices

questions.question: Which among the following is a cation?
questions.solution:
__
 
• **Ammonium**__ is a cation. 
 
• The cation is a positively charged ion. It has more protons than electrons.
 
• NH₃ forms a bond with an H+ using the N lone pair. Then, there is 1 more proton than electrons making it a cation.
 
• An anion is a negatively charged ion. It has more electrons than protons.
 
• Fluoride, Iodide, and Chloride are anions.

questions.question: Pravasi Bharatiya Divas is celebrated on:
questions.solution:

questions.question: In which year was the first amendment to the Constitution of India made?
questions.solution:
The correct answer is __**1951**__.

__
 
• **The first amendment to the Constitution of India was made in 1951**__.** **

 
 
• **The Constitution (First Amendment) Bill** sought to make several consequential changes from exempting land reforms from scrutiny to providing protections for backward classes in the Constitution.
 
• Insert provisions fully securing the constitutional validity of zamindari abolition laws in general and certain specified State Acts in particular
 
• The First Amendment Act amended articles 15, 19, 85, 87, 174, 176, 341, 342, 372, and 376.
 
• **Added Ninth Schedule** to **protect the land reforms** and other laws included in it from judicial review.** After Article 31, Articles 31A and 31B were inserted.**

questions.question: Where is the Dharmraja Ratha monument located?
questions.solution:
The **Dharmaraja Ratha monument** is located in __**Mahabalipuram, Tamil Nadu**__.

 
• It is a part of the five ‘Ratha’ structures and there are thirty-eight inscriptions on the Ratha.
 
• It has a monolith rock-cut. The porch has columns with lion bases and leads to the sanctuary.
 
• It is believed to be built during the end of the seventh century by Pallava King Narasimhavarman I.

questions.question: Which among the following is NOT an insulator?
questions.solution:
The correct answer is **Mercury**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Mercury** is NOT an insulator. 
 
• Insulators are material that does not conduct electricity.
 
• **Examples** - paper, plastic, rubber, glass, Ebonite, air, Styrofoam, etc.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• The Conductors are the material that conducts electricity.
 
• **Examples** - Metals, Aqueous solutions of salts ( ionic compounds dissolved in water), Mercury, graphite.
 
• Please note that Mercury is a poor conductor of heat. 
 
• Mercury forms weak bonds and is a liquid at room temperature.
 
• Atomic Number of Mercury-80, Symbol-Hg
